text: A functor F: 𝒞 → 𝒟 is required to preserve:
choices: nothing — it is just an assignment of objects
explanation: The functor axioms are F(id_A) = id_{F(A)} and F(g ∘ f) = F(g) ∘ F(f). Preservation of limits or of mono/epi properties is extra structure enjoyed only by special functors (e.g. right adjoints preserve limits).
